chapters.caption: Overhang bracket: a flat shelf, a 30° and a 60° underside
Before: the shelf layer is all volume hatch (green)
Surface angle and reference layers define downskin
After: the shelf rests on powder and gets downskin (blue)
30° underside: a narrow downskin strip along the edge
60° underside is steeper than 45°: no downskin
Layer by layer in 3D: blue starts at the shelf
Downskin hatch sits exactly under the overhang
